applicability: Marketplace Portal service. Policy edition 2026-09-01. Collection Profile and CORE terms are separate.
content:
Common failure reasons include insufficient available balance, a card limit, incorrect CVV, an invalid card and an issuer decline. Read the transaction's recorded reason before selecting a remedy.

The default funding source is the e-commerce balance. Same-name balance funding requires an eligible same-name collection account and configuration through the account manager. Check the card's current funding selection; cash in another account is not automatically the card's available funding.

Card limits can apply per transaction, day or card. Changing a limit is different from adding balance. For an issuer decline or unresolved card lock, provide the error for investigation.

The paying platform determines whether to request 3DS; CedarPay cannot manually suppress or force it. If SMS is unavailable, the supported card 3DS flow can deliver the code to the security email or display it under outstanding tasks / World Card → 3DS verification. These options do not replace the SMS requirement of a different bank-payment flow.
